description: WHEN CDEMO-PGM-ENTER AND CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = LIT-CCLISTPGM at app/cbl/COCRDSLC.cbl:339-340 - arrival from the card-list screen with the selection criteria already validated, and the only case in this folder that pins that arm together with a successful read. It is the second of the dispatcher's four arms and it matches only because the EVALUATE TRUE at :304 is ordered and first-match-wins: the PF3 arm at :305 does not match an ENTER AID, and the bare WHEN CDEMO-PGM-ENTER at :349 would have matched too, so an implementation that reordered them would silently skip the read this case exists to pin (gate G30, rule R7). :341-343 SET INPUT-OK TO TRUE, then move CDEMO-ACCT-ID into CC-ACCT-ID-N and CDEMO-CARD-NUM into CC-CARD-NUM-N through the numeric REDEFINES views app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy declares, so both criteria arrive as zero-filled images rather than as spaces. 9000-READ-DATA at :344-345 performs 9100-GETCARD-BYACCTCARD and nothing else; 9150-GETCARD-BYACCT at :779-810 is defined but never PERFORMed anywhere in the program, so the CARDAIX alternate path is unreachable from any whole-program case and is left dead rather than driven by an invented PERFORM (practice B5, and gate G45 - CARDAIX is a path over the CARDDAT base, never a second dataset, which is why inputs seeds CARDDAT alone). The READ at :742-750 keys CARDDAT on the sixteen-byte card number alone, EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD at :752 takes WHEN DFHRESP(NORMAL), and :753-754 sets FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT. 1200-SETUP-SCREEN-VARS therefore takes its ELSE at :461-486 - the arm a cold start never reaches, because the outer test at :459 is EIBCALEN and not the context flag - so :462-472 project ACCTSIDO and CARDSIDO from the non-zero criteria and, under IF FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT at :474, :475-484 project the embossed name, the expiry month and year split by the CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE-X redefines at :84-92 (CARD-EXPIRY-YEAR X(4), FILLER X(1), CARD-EXPIRY-MONTH X(2)) and the active status. All six are decoded from fixture row 0 of the 150-byte CARD-RECORD app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy declares, whose misspelled CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE is carried exactly as spelled. INFOMSGO is the 88-level FOUND-CARDS-FOR-ACCOUNT literal '   Displaying requested details' from :129-130, moved at :496 and space-padded into PIC X(40); ERRMSGO is 80 spaces because WS-RETURN-MSG was still SET WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF from :264 when :494 moved it; INFOMSGC is DFHNEUTR from :556 rather than the DFHBMDAR of :554, because an info message is now present. Because CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET is 'COCRDLI' and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is 'COCRDLIC', :505-508 takes the protect arm and moves DFHBMPRF into ACCTSIDA and CARDSIDA of CCRDSLAI rather than the DFHBMFSE of :510-511, and :527-531 moves DFHDFCOL into both criterion colour items - 0x00, indistinguishable from what MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CCRDSLAO at :428 already left there, and preserved rather than tidied. Those two protect attributes are behaviour but are not assertable as keys here: an xxxA item is the REDEFINES view of xxxF and the attributes map admits only the C, P, H and V planes, so DFHBMPRF is recorded in this description while the colour plane carries the assertion. No filter flag is NOT-OK or BLANK, so the cursor EVALUATE at :515-524 falls through both guarded arms to WHEN OTHER and moves -1 into ACCTSIDL, carried as cursorField because a cursor is an instruction to CICS rather than payload; nothing is invalid and the context is ENTER, so no DFHRED is written at :533-539 and the '*' at :541-545, which additionally requires CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, stays unwritten (gate G38, the ENTER side). No programmed-symbol or validation plane is written at all. 1400-SEND-SCREEN moves the X(8) literal 'COCRDSL ' into the X(7) CCARD-NEXT-MAPSET, right-truncating it to COCRDSL, sets CCARD-NEXT-MAP to CCRDSLA and SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER TO TRUE, which is why the returned CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is 1 where 0 arrived. COMMON-RETURN at :394-406 moves WS-RETURN-MSG to CCARD-ERROR-MSG, copies the 160-byte CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and then the 12-byte WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA at offset LENGTH OF CARDDEMO-COMMAREA + 1, and ends in EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(LIT-THISTRANID) - hence termination RETURN_TRANSID and not XCTL, the only XCTL being at :331-334 and reachable solely from the PF3 arm. All conversation state travels in the payload and none is retained server-side (gate G37, rule R6). expectedWrites is empty as a positive assertion that nothing was written - the program's only file verb is that one READ - and expectedFinalState pins all three seeded rows unchanged at their declared 150 bytes so no observed row goes unaccounted for. Coverage, so this folder stays auditable without re-reading the program: the EIBCALEN = 0 cold start, and with it the first disjunct of :268-270, is pinned by case01 and case19, while the second disjunct - CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM = LIT-MENUPGM AND NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER - is pinned by case18, so both disjuncts of that guard are exercised independently and this case is not spent duplicating either. The class name says Select and the program is a View, and neither is changed. CardSelectController is the prompt-mandated name and is kept verbatim under rule R1, while the behaviour asserted here comes from the source. Three independent readings corroborate the divergence: the header at :4 reads 'Accept and process credit card detail request', app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:220 reads DESCRIPTION(VIEW CARD DETAIL) against TRANSID(CCDL), and README.md documents CCDL as 'Credit Card View'. It is recorded rather than repaired (practice B4). Widths are mechanical rather than prose: the fifteen xxxI items of app/cpy-bms/COCRDSL.CPY sum to 387 and the group to 12 + 15 x 7 + 387 = 504, every field above is asserted at its declared width, and trailing spaces are written out rather than trimmed (practices B8 and B11). Determinism: the pinned instant 2022-07-19T23:12:33 is this program's own version footer at :886 - not the 23:16:00 of app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy:45, which belongs to a copybook rather than to COCRDSLC - so MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA, performed twice at :430 and :437, yields byte-identical CURDATEO 07/19/22 and CURTIMEO 23:12:33 on every run, and the code page is named US-ASCII explicitly rather than taken from the platform (practices B7 and B8). Provenance: every expected value was derived by structured reading of app/cbl/COCRDSLC.cbl cross-checked against the app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy byte layout, the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COCRDSL.CPY, app/bms/COCRDSL.bms and the real app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt consumed through its derived test copy so the reference tree stays read-only (practice B3). It was never captured from, replayed from or diffed against a live COBOL execution, which is empirically impossible here: no z/OS and no CICS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository (practice B12, plan risk R-A). Gates with no site in this case, stated so their absence is not mistaken for an omission: G32 does not apply because all nine GO TOs are forward - five to the shared terminal COMMON-RETURN, four to a paragraph -EXIT - so none forms a loop and CBSTM03A remains the only program needing restructuring; G35 does not apply because COCRDSLC contains no CALL 'CEE3ABD' at all, its abend path being the CICS-native HANDLE ABEND at :250-252 reaching ABEND ABCODE('9999') at :876; G39 does not apply because this screen declares no PAGENO; and G22 through G28 have no site because the program declares no PIC 9(n)V(n) monetary field, so no BigDecimal expectation belongs here.
